caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned slightly angled to the viewer's right. The chair features a carved backrest with a symmetrical, decorative design at the top and a central ornate panel with curved cutouts. The wood is depicted in various shades of brown, highlighting the grain and texture. The seat of the chair is upholstered with a flat, light green cushion. The chair has four legs, with the front two shaped in a cabriole style ending in rounded feet, and the rear two legs are plain and slightly angled backward. The drawing is centered within a lightly drawn rectangular border on an off-white background. There are no other objects or elements within the composition.
title: Walnut Chair
